parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html

租户ID。

parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the ID of the database.

> You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain the ID of a physical database and the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to obtain the ID of a logical database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
>您也可以通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html获取物理库的DatabaseId值，调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html获取逻辑库的DatabaseId值
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

*   true: The database is a physical database.
*   false: The database is a logical database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库是逻辑库，取值：
- true：物理库
- false：逻辑库
parameters.name: is_logic

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188103.html operation to obtain the name of the database.

*   You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the name of the database.
*   You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain the name of a physical database and the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to obtain the name of a logical database

parameters.help_en:
The new sensitivity level of the field that you want to specify. Valid values:

*   INNER: low sensitivity level
*   SENSITIVE: medium sensitivity level
*   CONFIDENTIAL: high sensitivity level
parameters.help_zh:
输入新的字段敏感等级，取值如下：

- INNER：低敏感
- SENSITIVE： 中敏感
- CONFIDENTIAL： 高敏感
parameters.name: new_level
